map.模型按自由空间传播加固定环境修正，不含金属反射、家具遮挡、同频干扰与终端差异。实: The model assumes free-space propagation plus fixed environment corrections and excludes metal reflections, furniture blockage, co-channel interference and terminal variation. For real deployment, keep 30% headroom on top of this and do a site survey.
